targets.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wildlife_camera" and r.camera == "hc960-01" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wildlife_camera" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.camera, set: ["hc960-01", "hc960-02", "hc960-03", "hc960-04", "hc960-05"]))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "camera"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "temperature_c")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.camera, set: ["hc960-01", "hc960-02", "hc960-03", "hc960-04", "hc960-05"]))

panels.title: Batterihistorikk
panels.description: Sist registrerte batterinivå per intervall for de valgte kameraene.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Wildlife")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wildlife_camera" and r._field == "image" and r._value == 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.camera, set: ["hc960-01", "hc960-02", "hc960-03", "hc960-04", "hc960-05"]))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["camera"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "images")
